## sqlpipe v2.0

### Breaking change

The `/v2/users` response no longer includes `name`. It now returns `first_name` and `last_name`.

Update clients before you upgrade to v2.0.

If your client reads `name`, change it to read both new fields.

If your client sends `name`, send `first_name` and `last_name` instead.

Test the updated client against v2.0 before production deployment.

### New flag

Use `--incremental` to process only new or changed records.

If you omit this flag, sqlpipe uses the full processing mode.

### Performance

sqlpipe writes Parquet data 40% faster in the v2.0 benchmark.

Actual speed depends on data size, storage, and system load.
